content.text:
I fixed `saveAll` in `store.js`. It used `items.forEach(async …)`, and `forEach` doesn't wait for async callbacks. So it returned the count straight away, before the writes had finished. A failed write also became an unhandled rejection instead of making `saveAll` reject.

It now does `await Promise.all(items.map((item) => db.put(item.id, item)))`. That waits for every write and rejects if any write fails. The writes still run in parallel, as before.

I added a test in `test/store.test.js` with a slow `db.put` and a failing `db.put`. The suite passes with both tests. I didn't run the new test against the old code, so I haven't seen it fail there.
